observations.hierarchy: Subject as dialog title, filled Reply first, Reply All/Forward outlined, More actions isolated at right; close X top-right.
observations.typography: Title ~24px, sender label 13px bold with value at body size, body 15px with comfortable leading.
observations.density_layout: Near-viewport dialog (40px scrim inset) holds a three-line message; body capped near 560px leaving most of the 1200px dialog empty for this state; a longer message would use the frame.
observations.color: Only Reply is orange; scrim dims the shell evenly.
observations.visible_affordances: Buttons and the native details disclosure triangle read correctly; "View raw email" underlined link is clear.
observations.coherence: Dialog uses the same button and divider vocabulary as the app.

files.caveat: Scrim hides the list; date and recipient details sit behind the collapsed disclosure and are not visible.

observations.shell: Contract sidebar visible beneath the scrim.
